conversation.message: Generative AI refers to artificial intelligence that can produce various types of content, such as images, text, audio, and synthetic data. It learns patterns from existing data to create new, original outputs.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So it essentially creates new things based on what it's already seen? That's quite impressive.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
